card.name: No more frequently than (titration spacing)
card.fires_on: The word 'than' (or 'more') in the phrase 'no more frequently than' in dose-titration instructions. It comes right before an interval such as 'once per week' or 'every 2 weeks'.

modes.label: Titration limit phrase
modes.description: 'than' or 'more' inside 'no more frequently than' before a time interval for increasing a dose.
